description: Prevent Inkling/Psionic from leaking raw native tool-call JSON into user-visible text when tool_choice=none or tool calls are exhausted across coax/lib/inky/loop.coax and psionic/platform/inkling-serve.c.

steps.send: Fix raw native tool-call JSON leaks under `tool_choice="none"` / disabled tools across Psionic and Inky: 1) In `psionic/platform/inkling-serve.c`, when tools are forbidden (`tool_choice="none"` or empty tools), intercept tool-name header tokens while `in_header` is active (before stepping them into the KV cache) and redirect cleanly to text (allowing at most one initial thinking block) instead of only catching `<|content_invoke_tool_json|>`. 2) In `coax/lib/inky/loop.coax`, add a closing notice right before `tool_choice="none"` takes effect and add defense-in-depth detection in `ik_loop_stream_end` so a bare leaked native tool-call JSON object (`{"name":"run_command","args":...}`) emitted after tools are disabled does not finish as a normal reply or poison history, with `#test` coverage. Verify with `coax/bin/coax test coax/lib/inky/loop.coax --library && coax/bin/coax test coax/lib/inky/run.coax --library` and verify `psionic/platform/inkling-serve.c` still builds cleanly.

graders.run: grep -q 'in_header' psionic/platform/inkling-serve.c && grep -q 'tools_forbidden\|bad_header\|saw_think' psionic/platform/inkling-serve.c && grep -q 'Tool calls are now disabled\|tools were disabled\|leaked' coax/lib/inky/loop.coax && coax/bin/coax test coax/lib/inky/loop.coax --library && coax/bin/coax test coax/lib/inky/run.coax --library && ./psionic/platform/inkling-build.sh /tmp/wf004-psionic-check >/dev/null && rm -rf /tmp/wf004-psionic-check
